rom_system: Simplified BGN/PCGN romanisation without diacritics or tones (e.g. "sabaidi", "khop chai"): ou = u, u = ɯ, x = ຊ, ny = ຍ, e = ເ and ແ. Made by our own syllable rules with laonlp word splitting, uroman only as a hint, then fixed by hand; checked on common words. Automatic, may contain errors.
